name: 36744 · Greensboro, AL
findings: ZIP 36744 (Greensboro) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36744 (Greensboro) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
